## review follow-ups of PR #33804 (card #33620, NUL-separated path reads)

Records: 6893545108, 6893808803 (review#1, PASS on head `f1a04f78`, nits only).

- [ ] N2 the CONTROL rows rely on git's default `core.quotePath`; `gitFreeEnv()` does not strip a user or system gitconfig, so a machine with `core.quotePath=false` reddens them (fails red, never falsely green). Pin `-c core.quotePath=true` in the fixture, or strip the global config.

The two real defects the records named outside this PR are carded on their own (filing gate per-defect rule): `dispatch-gates.mjs` `changedPathsFromGit` reads without `-z`; `dispatch-gates --commands` did not derive `check:pm-fleet-write-execute` for a diff changing a function the executor self-test fakes.

`scripts/pm/**`; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Waits for PR #33804.
